title: Adorable But doesn’t last long
text:
Adorable But doesn’t last long. Good value for price paid- great looking and even came with all the labels and extra pump.

*update - less than a month after use pump portion is useless. They do send you a replacement pump, but that broke too. I guess they knew the product was defective. Removed some stars...
